name: Burial
description:
Do you believe in the supernatural?

The main character of the game, videographer Vasily Panin, also didn’t believe it until he found himself in an old Soviet apartment in the middle of the night. He received the task of filming the wake, which would last until the morning. People will come and say goodbye to the deceased and all this needs to be captured on film. However, when Vasily gets into the apartment, he realizes that there is no way out of it anymore, and no one will come to the wake.

In the middle of the room there is a closed coffin and now Vasily needs to unravel all the secrets of the damned apartment and its owner in order to get out alive and not go crazy from wild horror...

What do the walls of this Soviet apartment hide within themselves, what horrors happened here and how is this connected with its owner? Do you have the courage to find the answers to these questions?

GAME FEATURES:

  • Scary atmosphere

  • Realistic sounds that immerse you in history

  • Realistic graphics

  • Found film effect

  • You need to look for objects and follow the plot

  • Great soundtrack that enhances the horror atmosphere

  • Completion time: about 60 minutes.
